BackstoryDef.title: reformed bandit
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made a poor bandit, and was eventually caught by a mercenary company. Serving out a labor sentence among them, [PAWN_pronoun] noticed how much better these people lived than [PAWN_pronoun] ever had - and chose to stay on once released.

BackstoryDef.title: retired medic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a medic in the armed forces, and was invalided out of the service early after a serious injury.

BackstoryDef.title: correctional officer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded captured bandits and raiders, keeping watch over them until their sentences ran out and they walked free.

BackstoryDef.title: laid-off bodyguard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a bodyguard for military contractors until automatroids proved they could do the job better, and [PAWN_pronoun] was laid off. In the end [PAWN_pronoun] signed onto a frontier project and came to the rimworld to make a living.

BackstoryDef.title: struggling mercenary
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fought as a mercenary for hire, but automatroids squeezed the mercenary trade out of existence - better in a fight, and cheaper by the hour. [PAWN_nameDef] proved that [PAWN_possessive] blood and sweat could still undercut an automatroid's lubricant.

BackstoryDef.title: frontier worker
BackstoryDef.description: The money and opportunity promised by frontier projects drew in crowds of out-of-work laborers like [PAWN_nameDef]. Like all the rest of them, [PAWN_pronoun] signed the liability waivers and shipped out to the rimworld.

BackstoryDef.title: megacorp coroner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked for a megacorporation as a forensic assistant, processing the bodies posted as credit collateral. With no connections to protect [PAWN_objective], the daily workload pushed [PAWN_objective] to the edge of collapse - but it also sharpened [PAWN_possessive] medical skills to a fine edge.

BackstoryDef.title: automatroid maintenance tech
BackstoryDef.description: As automatroid designs kept iterating, [PAWN_nameDef] was finally laid off from maintaining them. In an age overrun by automatroids, though, a technician who knows their insides is exactly what mercenaries, pirates and private armies are looking for.

BackstoryDef.title: lawless rogue
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] arrived on the rimworld with a frontier project and proceeded to do exactly as [PAWN_pronoun] pleased. Having offended a great many people and broken most of the contract, [PAWN_pronoun] is now hunted - which is very much the life [PAWN_pronoun] was after.

BackstoryDef.title: retired general
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once held high rank, until the infighting between the military and the arms industry needed a scapegoat. Old connections were enough to keep [PAWN_objective] alive, but not enough to keep [PAWN_objective] home - [PAWN_pronoun] left with a frontier project bound for the rimworld.

BackstoryDef.title: traumatized veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] gave [PAWN_possessive] youth to [PAWN_possessive] country, and the battlefield gave back post-traumatic stress. No proper treatment ever came after the war, and the grind of ordinary life eventually drove [PAWN_objective] out to the rimworld to make a living.

BackstoryDef.title: automatroid godfather
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hired and sheltered technicians to teach automatroids how to maintain themselves, and spent just as much time teaching them a philosophy of life. Plenty of people resent the automatroid outfit [PAWN_pronoun] built, but nobody has managed to shift [PAWN_objective] yet.
